pr_title: Remove async state machines from middlewares when they do nothing
pr_body:
**PR Title**
Remove async state machines from middlewares when they do nothing

**PR Description**
Searched for `await _next(` and found a couple more in src\Http and src\Middleware
- MapMiddleware
- MapWhenMiddleware
- UsePathBaseMiddleware
- MigrationsEndPointMiddleware
- HttpMethodOverrideMiddleware
- ResponseCompressionMiddleware
- SpaProxyMiddleware
- ConditionalProxyMiddleware
- IISMiddleware

Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/issues/34574

issue_context.title: Fast path the MapMiddleware negative case
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/dotnet/aspnetcore/blob/b25ef20e0014b0a75b6b037110090b0fb9bdca20/src/Http/Http.Abstractions/src/Extensions/MapMiddleware.cs#L81-L84

The MapMiddleware does not need async/await in the else branch. If an application uses several calls to Map it can create a lot of unnecessary state machines for each successive negative match. Move the logic from the positive branch into a sub method and remove async/await from the Invoke method.

Related to https://github.com/aspnet/AspNetKatana/issues/424.
comments: Glad to see the performance bug has gotten you @Tratcher 😅
Too many state machines might cause a stack overflow.
I'm like 90% sure that doesn't happen on .NET Core/5/6.
